source_record_subset.mysql: SELECT CAST( COUNT( `t1`.`id` ) AS DOUBLE ) / 12 FROM `postlinks` AS `t1` INNER JOIN `posts` AS `t2` ON `t1`.`postid` = `t2`.`id` WHERE `t2`.`answercount` <= 2 AND DATE_FORMAT( CAST( `t1`.`creationdate` AS DATETIME ) , '%Y' ) = '2010'
source_record_subset.cracksql: SELECT CAST( COUNT( "t1"."id" ) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) / 12 FROM "postlinks" AS "t1" INNER JOIN "posts" AS "t2" ON "t1"."postid" = "t2"."id" WHERE "t2"."answercount" <= 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST( "t1"."creationdate" AS TIMESTAMP )) = '2010'
